{{Quote|Last night, Trandoshan bounty hunters intercepted a package of ''extreme diplomatic'' importance, intended for ''Supreme Chancellor Palpatine''. They intend to sell it to the Separatists. You are going to make sure that situation does not occur.|The ARC trooper officer|<ref name="Package" />}}
An '''Advanced Recon Commando''' served as a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Intelligence officer/Legends|intelligence officer]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the war was [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|initiated]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] joined the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] and, within six [[Standard month/Legends|months]], was authorized to deliver briefs from within the [[Republic Intelligence headquarters|headquarters]] of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] gave one such briefing to two [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]], tasking them with a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Wars)|mission]] to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in order to retrieve a [[The Package|package]] for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Although the package was recovered successfully, all of the [[Gender/Legends|men]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the course of the operation, excluding [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sarge (clone commando)|Sarge]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wouldn't this be a better job for an ''ARC'' trooper?''"<br />"''Negative. Exchange is going to happen on Ord Mantell. Busy streets, lots of civilian interference. We need two teams, eight men, on the streets and ready.|Sarge and the ARC intelligence officer|<ref name="Package" />}}
[[File:Sarge_briefing.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ARC officer briefing two commando squads before their mission]]
An [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], he served as part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] elite [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]].<ref name="ARCTrooper" /> Following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] and the start of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the ARC trooper&mdash;along with the rest of his ARC comrades&mdash;became a part of the Republic's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] as an [[Intelligence officer/Legends|intelligence officer]].<ref name="TZ" />

By six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into the war's [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]], the ARC trooper had become authorized to issue briefings at the [[Republic Intelligence headquarters|headquarters]] of [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]]. It was in that capacity that he met with two [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] at Republic Intelligence headquarters, where he tasked them with a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Wars)|mission]]<ref name="Package" /> to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] explained that a [[The Package|diplomatic package]] bound for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] had been intercepted and stolen by a gang of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters, who were aiming to sell it to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Because of its importance, the ARC trooper tasked the two squads to travel to Ord Mantell and reacquire the package from the Trandoshans, in order to deliver it to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The package was successfully recovered and the Trandoshan [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] [[Death/Legends|killed]]. However, all of the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] in both squads perished during the mission, with the exception of clone commando<ref name="Package" /> [[Sarge (clone commando)|Sarge]].<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Sir, any idea what's in the package?''"<br />"''No. But you will die for this parcel, if it comes to that. Understood?''"<br />"''Affirmative.|Sarge and the ARC officer|<ref name="Package" />}}
As a clone of Jango Fett, the ARC officer stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height.<ref name="ARCTrooper" /> Many ARC [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were personally trained as an ARC trooper by Fett and possessed the Mandalorian's ruthlessness and efficiency. These troopers were trained to be self-sufficient, although they were not entirely independent, and were also taught to rely on themselves, although they were not completely independent.<ref name="TCW CG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The ARC officer wore a set of [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I class]] [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|armor]], equipped with a blast-dampening [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']] and a rank-signifying [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]]; the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] itself was adorned with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] markings. He expected both squads of commandos to risk their lives in order to ensure a successful retrieval of the diplomatic package.<ref name="Package" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ARC intelligence officer was introduced in the short story ''[[The Package (comic story)|The Package]]'', which was one of four [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] compiled in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 3|third volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] trade paperbacks. The character was created by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and drawn by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]].<ref name="Package" />
